description.value: Quartz is one of three Scandinavian-inspired deluxe cottages at Nectar Yoga Retreat, a wellness sanctuary nestled on 20 forested acres on Bowen Island, a 20-minute ferry ride from Horseshoe Bay. The cottage sleeps 1-2 guests and features a covered cedar porch, reading nook, ensuite bathroom with indoor and outdoor shower, and a stay package that includes daily breakfast, yoga, and meditation. Bowen Island itself offers mountain biking, hiking, kayaking, and a tight-knit island community for cyclists exploring the region.
